descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 20 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
This is NOT another extraction shooter.

ESCAPE FROM X is a milsim co-op tactical simulator where every raid is a fresh Zero-to-Hero journey.

NOTE: Co-op coming soon!

# 💬 JOIN THE COMMUNITY

Be part of the development.
Share your raid stories, suggest new features, and help forge the ultimate VR mil-sim.

👉 Discord: https://discord.gg/Je33jR5nh

👉 YouTube :  look for @BadjoEntertainment  showcasing every feature in action

You find weapons, silencers, backpacks, and the Hero Key through real storytelling moments.
[media]

This is not about hoarding loot. Starting Glock – Zero to Hero in every single raid.
[media]

It’s about developing real skills: movement under fire, threat detection, recoil control, smart positioning, and split-second decisions.
[media]

NOTE: ESCAPE FROM X is currently in Early Access Beta. Thanks for riding with us.
[media]

WHAT MAKES ESCAPE-FROM-X UNIQUE:
• No Floating Menus – Full immersion from the first second.
[media]

• Real NPC Body Physics – Push enemies to the ground with your hands, shoot their legs to slow them down and buy time.
[media]
[media]

• Follow the Clues – Uncover the bigger story one Polaroid at a time.
[media]

• Have fun while building real skills. This is Virtual Reality.
[media]

COMPETE & PROGRESS
• Treasure Hunter Leaderboard – Collect rare items
• Kill Leaderboard – Pure shooting skill
• Hardcore Leaderboard – For the real operators

Every map location offers different gear routes, giving you high replayability and multiple ways to approach each raid.
[media]

💀 All About Shooting – Feel the chaos.
Welcome to ESCAPE FROM X.
